title: arenaria stricta subsp. macra
intro: Arenaria stricta subsp. macra, commonly known as mountain sandwort, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. Therapeutically, Arenaria stricta subsp. macra is believed to exhibit actions such as immunomodulation, vasodilation, and analgesia, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
